topic: SehatFlow: drug interaction checker built into the sale
caption:
A safety check that lives where the sale happens. 💊

One of the features we built into SehatFlow, our pharmacy management platform, is a built-in drug interaction checker.

Why build it in instead of bolting it on?

▸ It sits in the same workspace as sales, so there's no extra tool to open
▸ It's right there at the counter, when it matters
▸ It shares one platform with inventory, purchasing and reporting

That's how we think about product design: put the right tool exactly where the work happens.

Run a pharmacy? Take a look at sehatflow.com 🔗

Share this with a pharmacist you know. 🔁
